Subplan 006 adds an optional pre-connect reservation hook, held by the actual connection task and attached to the socket lifetime after birth; fixed-upstream behavior defaults to no reservation.
Rill modifications: per-peer verify context, strict TLS h2 ALPN; upstream connection birth callback in PeerOptions and TransportConnector; zstd pinned to pre-existing lockfile version; upstream test character written as a Rust Unicode escape to comply with the repository character policy (test bytes unchanged).
